title: 2016 AMC 12A Problem 22
statement: How many ordered triples \((x,y,z)\) of positive integers satisfy \(\text{lcm}(x,y)=72,\) \(\text{lcm}(x,z)=600,\) and \(\text{lcm}(y,z)=900?\)

solutions.text:
Because \(\text{lcm}(x,y)=2^3\cdot3^2\) and \(\text{lcm}(x,z)=2^3\cdot3\cdot5^2,\) the factor \(5^2\) divides \(z\) while neither \(x\) nor \(y\) is divisible by \(5.\) Also \(3^2\) divides \(y,\) while neither \(x\) nor \(z\) is divisible by \(3^2,\) and \(x\) must have the factor \(2^3.\)

Writing \(x=2^3\cdot3^{\,j},\) \(y=2^{\,k}\cdot3^2,\) and \(z=2^{\,m}\cdot3^{\,n}\cdot5^2,\) the lcm conditions require \(\max(j,n)=1\) and \(\max(k,m)=2.\) The first pair can be \((1,0),(0,1),(1,1),\) and the second can be \((2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(0,2),(1,2).\) Thus there are \(3\cdot5=15\) ordered triples.

Thus, the correct answer is A.
